title: Log types a ZPA log receiver can carry, and their codes

prose.text: The help, the API and the tools name the log types differently and accept different sets of them.

prose.label: The types.
prose.text: {{help-log-types}} The field schemas of the per-type logs are in the legacy references: User Activity [[zpa.logs.user-activity]], User Status [[zpa.logs.user-status]], App Connector Status [[zpa.logs.control-session-status]], App Connector Metrics [[zpa.logs.app-connector-metrics]], Browser Access [[zpa.logs.browser-access]], Microsegmentation Flow [[zpa.logs.microsegmentation-flow]], Private Service Edge Status [[zpa.logs.control-session-status]] and Metrics [[zpa.logs.service-edge-metrics]], Private Cloud Controller Status [[zpa.logs.control-session-status]] and Metrics [[zpa.logs.service-edge-metrics]].

prose.label: Single types.
prose.text: The audit log stream is in [[zpa.audit-logs.streaming]], the AppProtection stream in [[zpa.appprotection.logging]] and the Browser Access stream in [[zpa.browser-access.logs]].

Whether the API accepts the codes the provider's resource rejects was an open question until the API article was captured {{gap:format-only-codes}}. One format-lookup code has no label in any source {{gap:auth-log-1id-label}}.

help-log-types.statement: The Log Streaming Service page lists nineteen log types a receiver can capture: AppProtection, Audit Logs, App Connector Metrics, App Connector Status, Browser Access Logs, Business Continuity Event Log Fields, KRB Inspection Logs, LDAP Inspection Logs, Microsegmentation, Private Cloud Controller Metrics and Status, two User Status VPN Service Edge types, Traffic Flow - VPN, Private Service Edge Metrics and Status, SMB Inspection Logs, User Activity and User Status.

quotes:
A log receiver can capture several log types.
- View the log types.
- AppProtection: Information related to AppProtection policy activity in your organization.
Audit Logs: Session information for all admins accessing the Zscaler Admin Console.
App Connector Metrics: Information related to an App Connector's metrics.
App Connector Status: Information related to an App Connector's availability and connection to Private Access.
Browser Access Logs: HTTP log information related to Browser Access.
Business Continuity Event Log Fields: Information related to Business Continuity Events activity.
KRB Inspection Logs: Information related to Kerberos inspection log activity in your organization.
LDAP Inspection Logs: Information related to LDAP inspection log activity in your organization.
Microsegmentation: Information related to Microsegmentation Flow activity.
Private Cloud Controller Metrics: Information related to a Private Cloud Controller's metrics.
Private Cloud Controller Status: Information related to a Private Cloud Controller's availability and connection to Private Access.
User Status - VPN Service Edge (IP Address Reservation): Information related to a user status for VPN (ZPA Service Edge).
User Status - [[variable:vpn-service-edge]]: Information related to a user status for VPN Service Edge.
Traffic Flow - VPN: Information related to VPN traffic flow metrics.
Private Service Edge Metrics: Information related to a Private Service Edge's metrics.
Private Service Edge Status: Information related to a Private Service Edge's availability and connection to Private Access.
SMB Inspection Logs: Information related to SMB inspection log activity in your organization.
User Activity: Information on end user requests to applications.

User Status: Information related to an end user's availability and connection to Private Access. To learn more, see Understanding User Status Log Fields.
After you select which log type to capture

tf-narrower-than-api.statement: The Terraform resource rejects six codes the API article lists as supported for a receiver: zpn_smb_inspection_log, zpn_ldap_inspection_log, zpn_krb_inspection_log, zpn_sitec_auth_log, zpn_sitec_comprehensive_stats and zms_flow_log, so those receivers cannot be created through the resource.
tf-narrower-than-api.conditions: Set difference between the two sourceLogType lists; the resource validates source_log_type with validation.StringInSlice, which rejects any value outside its list. The server-side behavior of the API is taken from the article, not tested.

format-only-codes.title: Whether the API accepts the format-only codes on a receiver's sourceLogType
format-only-codes.detail: Tracked as legacy ledger item zpa-41: seven codes in the format-lookup list were absent from the Python SDK map and from the Terraform resource validator, and receiver acceptance was unconfirmed.
format-only-codes.resolution: The LSS API article lists zms_flow_log, zpn_sitec_comprehensive_stats, zpn_sitec_auth_log, zpn_smb_inspection_log, zpn_ldap_inspection_log and zpn_krb_inspection_log among the supported sourceLogType values (claim code-map); zpn_auth_log_1id is not in that list and remains open (auth-log-1id-label).

auth-log-1id-label.title: What zpn_auth_log_1id is
auth-log-1id-label.detail: Tracked as legacy ledger item zpa-40. The code is a valid log_type for the format-lookup data source (tf-format-lookup-types) and appears in no other source: not in the API article's list of sourceLogType values, not in the Log Streaming Service page and not in the Python SDK. Unverified legacy statement: "User Status (Zidentity) (inferred)", a label inferred from the auth_log stem and the _1id suffix.
